boxes.box: `main` contains the foundation; `git ls-files` shows no build output, and a secret scan of the tree is clean
boxes.evidence: Canonical .git/refs/heads/main = 67e6d1c94cf9941a4c61d412c9aa7df2585ee6cb. In the clone, `rtk proxy git log --oneline` shows 67e6d1c → a8d8f31 → 4a7a6ea → 7fe8191, and `rtk proxy git status --short --branch` shows `## main...origin/main` with nothing changed, even after all gates ran. `rtk proxy git ls-files` lists 313 paths. None of them is dist*/, .expo/, build/, coverage/, node_modules, supabase/.temp, supabase/.branches or .env*, except apps/mobile/.env.example, whose publishable key is empty. .gitignore:10-24 covers these paths. Gitleaks: bootstrap-gates.md:21 records the final run after the fix as 309 candidate files, exit 0, no findings. My own scan of the clone found no sb_secret_ keys, sb_publishable_ values, JWTs, PEM keys, AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/Slack/Google tokens or literal secret assignments. The only matches were env() references at config.toml:102,302,334 and a UI label at i18n/app.ts:36.
